## Provenance statement

This document is the auditable old-to-new map produced by `git filter-repo`, verified by tree diff: for every cited commit, the rewritten tree differs from the pre-rewrite tree only by deletion of the oversized paths that were never inputs to any sealed run. Content hashes of all `raw/` and `derived/` files are unchanged across the rewrite. The pre-rewrite object graph is archived in an out-of-repo git bundle and tagged locally as `prerewrite/875dc74`.
